privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.whoWeAreBody: MixHive is a social platform for DJs, producers and underground music creators, operated from Antwerp, Belgium. This policy explains what personal data we process and your rights under the GDPR (and equivalent laws such as LGPD, APPI and PIPA). For the purposes of data protection law, the data controller is MixHive (contact via your account settings or privacy@mixhive.app).
privacy.dataBody: Account data (email, profile, links), content you upload (mixes, playlists, comments), social graph (follows, messages), payment metadata (processed by Stripe; we do not store card numbers), consent records, and limited technical data (IP address, user agent — stored only in consent audit logs). Analytics are only collected if you opt in via the cookie banner.
privacy.legalBody: We rely on: contract performance (to provide the service), consent (for optional analytics and marketing communications), legitimate interest (security, fraud prevention, and platform integrity), and legal obligation (financial record retention for tax purposes).
privacy.retentionBody: Account data is retained until you request deletion. Consent records are kept for 3 years for audit purposes. Payment and financial records are retained for 7 years as required by Belgian tax law. Analytics data (if opted in) is retained for 13 months. Upon account deletion, personal data is purged within 30 days, except where retention is legally required.
privacy.transfersBody: Our infrastructure is provided by Supabase (United States) and Vercel (United States). Payment processing is handled by Stripe (United States). Where personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area, we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses or other appropriate safeguards as required by GDPR Chapter V.
privacy.thirdPartiesBody: We share data with the following processors solely to provide the service: Supabase (database, authentication, storage), Vercel (hosting, edge functions, analytics), Stripe (payment processing, marketplace escrow), Google (OAuth sign-in), and Sentry (error monitoring). We do not sell personal data to third parties.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to access, rectify, and export your data (Settings → Privacy & Data), request erasure within a 30-day window, restrict processing, object to processing based on legitimate interest, and data portability. You may withdraw analytics consent at any time via the cookie banner. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
privacy.supervisoryBody: If you believe your data protection rights have been infringed, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (Autorité de protection des données / Gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit), Rue de la Presse 35, 1000 Brussels, Belgium, contact@apd-gba.be.
privacy.automatedBody: MixHive does not use automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal effects or similarly significantly affects you. AI-powered features (agent suggestions, audio analysis) are assistive tools and do not make autonomous decisions about your account.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy requests, contact us via your account settings or email privacy@mixhive.app. We will respond to all requests within 30 days. Localized versions of this policy will accompany regional launches.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.ageBody: You must be at least 16 years old to use MixHive. If you are under 16, you may only use the platform with the consent of a parent or legal guardian. By using MixHive, you represent that you meet this age requirement.
terms.acceptableUseBody: You agree to upload only content you have the rights to share, to respect other creators, and to follow the community guidelines. Abuse, harassment, hate speech, and copyright infringement may result in content removal, account suspension, or permanent ban.
terms.yourContentBody: You retain ownership of the mixes and material you publish. You grant MixHive a limited, non-exclusive licence to host, display, and distribute your content on the platform so it can function. You may remove your content at any time.
terms.marketplaceBody: Gear and agent marketplace transactions are processed via Stripe. Escrow and payout terms are shown at the point of sale. MixHive charges a platform fee of 2.5%–5% on gear sales (sliding scale based on item price) and 30% on agent purchases. All payments are final unless a dispute is filed within 14 days.
terms.dsaBody: Under the Digital Services Act, we provide mechanisms to report illegal content or content that violates our terms. You can report content via the report button on any mix, profile, or message. We will review all reports and take appropriate action, which may include content removal, account restriction, or referral to law enforcement.
terms.liabilityBody: MixHive is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount you paid to MixHive in the 12 months preceding the claim.
terms.governingLawBody: These terms are governed by Belgian law. Any disputes shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Brussels, Belgium, unless otherwise required by consumer protection law in your jurisdiction.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be communicated in-app at least 30 days before they take effect. Continued use of the platform after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.necessaryBody: Required to sign you in, keep your session, and run core features. These are always on and cannot be disabled.
cookies.analyticsBody: If you accept analytics, we use privacy-respecting product analytics (Vercel Analytics) to understand usage and improve MixHive. These are only loaded after you opt in via the consent banner.
cookies.marketingBody: Marketing cookies help us deliver personalised updates about new features and events. These are only loaded if you explicitly opt in.
cookies.declarationBody: The table below lists all cookies used by MixHive:
cookies.thirdPartyBody: Google OAuth sets a session cookie when you sign in with Google. This cookie is managed by Google and is subject to Google's own cookie policy.
cookies.managingBody: Your consent is stored on this device and recorded against your account if you are signed in. You can change your preferences at any time by clicking "Cookie Settings" in the footer. Clearing site data also resets the banner.
cookies.browserBody: You can also control cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. Note that blocking necessary cookies may prevent MixHive from functioning correctly.
